decision: Both categories are eligible for this diagnostic auxiliary extraction, provided the waveform is command-free, finite and cap-free and the full128-sample extractor returns genuine nonempty, finite estimates.
rationale: Failure to identify modes from64 samples does not establish failure from128 samples. Likewise, an undefined forecast score is not evidence that all full-window information is absent. Neither case establishes reliable margin information.
conditions: Separate finite skill<.5, prefix-no-mode, and undefined suffix-variance cases. Unexpected numerical/solver failures must remain explicit failures, not be silently reclassified as ordinary undefined scores.
Keep original observed/age values and qualification unchanged; preserve cached accepted rows.

Use finite-skill-only versus combined accounting as a sensitivity analysis, not a label-informed choice of predictor eligibility or an additional fitting sweep. Freeze combined eligibility before scoring its leverage.
authorization: Continue the receipt with both categories. Fits remain unauthorized until the population-level provenance, floor and leverage evidence is reviewed.
